abstract: CTA started 2024 with a robust CES trade show and will end the year with a new logo that, for the first time, ties together CTA and CES under one brand mark. CES was stronger than ever-with more than 4,300 exhibitors and an incredible 1,442 startups at Eureka Park. There was a palpable sense of camaraderie and excitement among the 138 thousand attendees who celebrated with us as CTA commemorated its 100th anniversary. We remain committed to our mission as we join with our 1,300 member companies to create standards, promote innovative ideas, host events, and fight for policies that encourage innovation.
